author: Garrett Ball
title: Jalen Duren planning to explore sign-and-trade options
desc: Jalen Duren is expected to explore sign-and-trade options after he and his camp were underwhelmed by the Pistons initial offer. Sam Amick of The Athletic noted Duren and the team are at an impasse after a season of mixed results. On the one hand, Duren had a great 2025-26 season, but floundered in the playoffs. Given that, the team is hesitant to hand him the massive contract he is now eligible for because of his All-NBA selection.
impact: This could have massive implications for the Pistons in 2026 if Duren leaves, especially since they traded Isaiah Stewart during the draft. If Duren finds himself on another team this offseason, the Pistons will have a big hole to fill in their starting lineup, and that player could have a lot of fantasy value given Detroit's style of play.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kevin Porter Jr. picks up player option with Bucks
desc: Kevin Porter Jr. has picked up his player option for the 2026-27 season.
impact: Porter was limited to 38 games last season due to injuries. He is in line to see a much bigger role as long as he can stay healthy with the departure of Giannis Antetokounmpo.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mouhamed Gueye has team option exercised by Hawks
desc: The Hawks exercised Mouhamed Gueye's option for the 2026-27 season.
impact: Gueye appeared in a career-high 77 games last season. He is likely to remain in a reserve role off the bench.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Karlo Matkovic has team option exercised by Pelicans
desc: The Pelicans exercised Karl Matković's option for the 2026-27 season.
impact: Matkovic appeared in 62 games last season. He is likely to remain in a reserve role for New Orleans.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mitchell Robinson unlikely to return to Knicks
desc: It is reportedly unlikely that Mitchell Robinson will return to the Knicks in free agency.
impact: Robinson is set to become an unrestricted free agent. The Knicks will have to make a decision on who they want to bring back and let go in free agency. This will remain a situation to monitor heading into free agency.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Mark Williams to sign a three-year deal with Suns
desc: Mark Williams intends to sign a three year, $38 million deal with the Phoenix Suns.
impact: Williams joined the Suns via trade during the 2025-26 season and nearly averaged a double-double as a starter. It's gives the team a cheap deal allowing them to have some flexibility moving forward, and for Williams, financial security.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kawhi Leonard prefers to remain with Clippers, linked to Raptors
desc: Kawhi Leonard reportedly prefers to remain with the Clippers, but he would be open to signing an extension with the Raptors.
impact: The Clippers are currently in a weird spot as an organization. The Raptors appear to have interest in bringing back Leonard. The Spurs have also been connected to him.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Graham Ike signs Exhibit 10 deal with Warriors
desc: Graham Ike agreed to an Exhibit 10 deal with the Warriors.
impact: Ike lands in a favorable spot with a Golden State team that can use more size. He was a double-double machine in college at Wyoming and Gonzaga.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tamin Lipsey signs Exhibit 10 deal with Pacers
desc: Iowa State's Tamin Lipsey has agreed to an Exhibit 10 deal with the Indiana Pacers.
impact: Lipsey had an impressive collegiate career at Iowa State. He will look to prove himself in the Summer League in July.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Coby White to sign a 3-year, $74 million deal with Hornets
desc: Coby White intends to sign a 3-year, $74 million deal to stay with the Charlotte Hornets.
impact: The status of the Hornets backcourt was up in the air with the trade of LaMelo Ball to Minnesota and the uncertainty of White's signing. Now that White has decided to stay, he should find himself in the starting lineup and the Hornets will have plenty of continuity to build off of as they look to become competitive in the East.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Quadir Copeland signs two-way contract with Rockets
desc: The Rockets signed Quadir Copeland to a two-way contract.
impact: Copeland began his collegiate career at Syracuse before transferring to McNeese and North Carolina State. He averaged 14 points on 49.4 percent shooting from the field with the Wolfpack. He'll look to prove himself in the Summer League.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Rafael Castro signs two-way contract with Bucks
desc: The Bucks signed Rafael Castro to a two-way contract.
impact: Castro just missed averaging a double-double in his final season in college after transferring to George Washington. He'll look to prove himself in the Summer League in July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Peter Suder signs two-way contract with Lakers
desc: The Lakers signed Peter Suder to a two-way contract.
impact: Suder finished his collegiate career at Miami (OH) where he averaged 14 points on 54.6 percent shooting from the field. He'll look to prove himself in the Summer League in July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Lamar Wilkerson signs Exhibit 10 contract with Thunder
desc: The Thunder signed Lamar Wilkerson to an Exhibit 10 contract.
impact: Wilkerson averaged just under 21 points in his final collegiate season at Indiana. He spent his first three seasons in college at Sam Houston State. He'll look to prove himself in the Summer League.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Al Horford signs two-year contract with Warriors
desc: The Warriors signed Al Horford to a two-year, $14 million contract.
impact: Horford returns to Golden State after declining his player option. He is entering his 20th season in the NBA. He'll likely remain in his reserve role with the Warriors.
